oven.note: Confirmed via individually indexed official mieleusa.com fault-code pages; direct WebFetch was blocked by site bot-protection (403).

codes.meaning: The steam oven's water line into the steam generator isn't delivering water properly.
Water is not able to drain out of the steam generator after a cycle.
The pyrolytic self-clean cycle couldn't reach the very high temperature it needs, often from heavy food residue absorbing heat.
The oven door failed to lock before a pyrolytic self-clean cycle started.
The optional meat-probe thermometer accessory has itself failed.
On combi-steam ovens, the float switches monitoring the internal water reservoir are stuck.

refrigerator.note: Confirmed via individually indexed official mieleusa.com fault-code pages; direct WebFetch was blocked by site bot-protection (403).

codes.meaning: The sensor dedicated to the fresh-food/BioFresh drawer has failed.
The main sensor measuring temperature inside the refrigerator compartment has stopped reporting correctly.
The sensor on the refrigerator section's evaporator coil has failed, which can throw off the automatic defrost cycle.
The fresh-food compartment door has been left open continuously for about 15 minutes.
The fresh-food compartment door has stayed open for roughly 30 minutes.
The unit's control software has locked up or crashed and needs a power cycle.

dishwasher.note: Confirmed via individually indexed official mieleusa.com fault-code pages; direct WebFetch was blocked by site bot-protection (403).

codes.meaning: Water isn't draining out of the tub quickly enough.
The incoming water supply line is blocked or restricted.
Wash water didn't reach its target temperature in time, linked to a bad heater relay or failed heating element.
The pressure switch that senses water level in the sump has malfunctioned.
The circulation pump that sprays water during the wash is turning slower than it should.
The circulation pump has physically seized.

washer.note: Confirmed via individually indexed official mieleusa.com fault-code pages; direct WebFetch was blocked by site bot-protection (403).

codes.meaning: The incoming water supply is restricted.
The washer can't pump water out of the drum fast enough.
An excessive amount of detergent or additive was used in the load.
A technical malfunction in the washer's built-in steam generator on equipped models.
The door latch failed to lock at the start of a cycle.
The reverse problem of F34 — the door latch won't release once a cycle has finished.

freezer.note: Confirmed via individually indexed official mieleusa.com fault-code pages; direct WebFetch was blocked by site bot-protection (403).

codes.meaning: The sensor reading air temperature inside the freezer compartment has failed.
The freezer door has been left open continuously for about 15 minutes.
The freezer door has stayed open for around 30 minutes.
The freezer door has been open for about 45 minutes.
The automatic ice maker has a mechanical or electrical malfunction.
The ice maker's water-fill system has an issue.

dryer.note: Confirmed via individually indexed official mieleusa.com fault-code pages; direct WebFetch was blocked by site bot-protection (403).

codes.meaning: The reed switch that confirms the door is closed has failed.
An internal electronic/memory component on the control board has failed.
A cycle finished without fully drying the load even after the full maximum drying time.
Airflow through the dryer is restricted, most often from a dirty lint/condenser filter.
The electrical voltage reaching the drum's drive motor is below what the motor needs.
Another internal electronic control-board fault.
